sentences: The government announced a nationwide lockdown to slow the spread of COVID.
During lockdown people were only allowed to leave home for essential activities.
The lockdown forced millions of workers to transition to remote work overnight.
Small businesses struggled to survive during months of strict lockdown measures.
Mental health issues surged during the prolonged lockdown period.
The lockdown was extended for another two weeks as case numbers continued to rise.
People found creative ways to socialize during lockdown using video calls.
The economy contracted sharply during the first months of the national lockdown.
Lockdown restrictions varied significantly between different states and countries.
Many couples reported relationship strain after months of lockdown together.
The lockdown led to a surge in online shopping and home delivery services.
Schools shifted to remote learning when the lockdown closed campuses indefinitely.
Lockdown fatigue caused many people to ignore social distancing guidelines.
The strictest lockdown measures were implemented during the winter surge.
Artists created powerful works reflecting the isolation of lockdown life.
Domestic violence reports increased significantly during the lockdown period.
The phased lifting of lockdown restrictions began in the spring of 2021.
Lockdown protests erupted in several cities as public patience wore thin.
The economic impact of lockdown was felt most by hourly wage workers.
Historians will study the global lockdown as a defining event of the decade.
